prompt.project_info: A sun-soaked wildflower-field fashion portrait balancing cool blue blooms with warm high-contrast daylight.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with long dark-brown wavy windblown hair, a serene peaceful expression, closed relaxed eyelids, and a profile turned toward the light. She wears a black mini dress with red polka dots, off-the-shoulder ruffled sleeves, a sweetheart neckline, a thin gold chain necklace, and rings.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium-full eye-level to slightly low-angle portrait with a low horizon. She kneels or sits relaxed among dense vibrant blue wildflowers, torso upright, head gently tilted back and toward side light, fingers resting naturally on her legs. Rolling brown hills and wispy cirrus clouds remain in the background; no text, logo, or watermark.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural hard side sunlight from the left at about 5500K creates distinct profile and neck shadows while wind moves the hair. Use cool blue shadows against warm sunlit skin, medium-high contrast, and a serene open-air mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 50mm or 85mm portrait lens at f/2.8 to f/4, fast shutter to freeze hair movement, fine grain, sharp subject with slightly softened field and hills.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Medium full fashion portrait of an adult woman with long dark wavy windblown hair kneeling or sitting in a dense field of vibrant blue wildflowers. Serene peaceful expression, eyes closed, head tilted back slightly and turned to the side toward the light, arms relaxed with fingers resting naturally on legs. Black mini dress with red polka dots, off-the-shoulder ruffled sleeves, sweetheart neckline, thin gold chain necklace, and rings. Central composition with low horizon, eye-level to slightly low angle, rolling brown hills in the distance, blue sky with wispy cirrus clouds, sunny and windy. Natural hard side sunlight from the left at approximately 5500K, high contrast, distinct profile and neck shadows, cool blue shadow tones contrasting with warm highlights, 50mm or 85mm portrait lens at f/2.8 to f/4, fast shutter to freeze hair motion, fine grain, no text, logos, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, body-part emphasis, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, readable text, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference asset is required. If approved person, wardrobe, or location references are attached, preserve the supplied adult identity where appropriate, black-and-red polka-dot dress, windblown hair, relaxed flower-field pose, blue blooms, low horizon, hills, and hard left-side sunlight. Individual identity, dress details, and flower species may be replaced.
